question: Does robustness-oriented fine-tuning improve closed-loop success under distribution shift?
primary_evidence: M2-LE−M1 paired effects: L3=+26.7 pp, photo=-10.0 pp, noise=+10.0 pp, combined=+17.3 pp.

question: How does language variation affect SmolVLA and does language-aware training help?
primary_evidence: Seed-42 L0/L1/L2/L3 curves compare M1, M2-L and M2-LE; multi-seed held-out L3 effect=+26.7 pp.

question: Which evaluated environmental perturbations cause the strongest degradation?
primary_evidence: Primary generalization gaps quantify photometric and held-out sensor-noise degradation for M1 and M2-LE.

question: Does robustness training transfer to held-out perturbation categories?
primary_evidence: Held-out L3 effect=+26.7 pp; held-out noise effect=+10.0 pp.
supplementary_e5_note: Supplementary E5 composed held-out L3 language with held-out Gaussian noise. M2-LE−M1=16.7 pp, 95% hierarchical-bootstrap CI [4.7, 31.3] pp; 3/3 seeds improved. This is exploratory evidence and does not alter the original confirmatory family.

question: Is robustness associated with an ID-performance trade-off?
primary_evidence: ID M2-LE−M1 paired effect=-6.7 pp; M1 mean ID=0.513, M2-LE mean ID=0.447.
